title: incident-bot: enrich on-call context for automated diagnostics and runbooks
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: improve on-call efficiency by attaching richer context to incident-bot automated diagnostics and runbook suggestions so that responders get targeted links and metadata (svc ownership, recent deploys, related alerts, postmortem links) in the initial notification. This change implements an enrichment pipeline that pulls information from the SLO toolkit, deployment metadata service, and our internal runbook index, attaches a TTL-aware context blob to each incident summary, and surfaces prioritized runbook links in the Slack/Email notifications. Key changes: 1) new enrichment module (src/enrichment/*) with pluggable adapters for SLO, deploys, and runbooks; 2) expanded incident schema to include context_blob (base64 JSON) and priority_links; 3) protection for sensitive fields via allowlist and KMS-encrypted fields; 4) on-call templates updated to render prioritized links and short context snippets; 5) unit and integration tests for enrichment adapters and TTL behavior; 6) docs/runbooks.md updated with examples and operational runbook for debugging enrichment failures. Checklist: - [x] design doc reviewed (ENG-8721) - [x] adapters implemented and unit-tested - [x] integration test against staging runbook index - [x] docs updated and quickstart added - [x] rollout plan with feature flag ready Testing/CI: added unit tests and an integration job that exercises the enrichment pipeline against a staging runbook index. One flaky test in unit-tests was caused by a timing assumption and was fixed; CI required a rerun but ultimately passed. Rollout: feature guarded by incident.enrichment feature flag; initial rollout to 10% of alerts for SRE teams, then broader rollout after 48h telemetry check. Monitoring: new metrics incident_enrichment.success_count, incident_enrichment.latency_ms, incident_enrichment.ttl_miss_count; added alerts for enrichment failure rate > 5% and latency p95 > 500ms. Backout: disable feature flag to revert to the previous lightweight notifications. Security/Privacy: ensure no PII is added by default and KMS encrypt any customer-sensitive fields. Links: design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-8721, runbook index: https://internal.runbooks/redwood, deploy metadata service: https://deploy-metadata.internal/ (staging).
